name: SendCutSend
how_read: Plain HTTPS page fetch, no account, no quote; figures copied as published. Prose quotes are verbatim; 'table_row' quotes name the table, row and cells.
not_read: Per-thickness 'View specs' sheets on each material page (minimum hole, minimum bridge, tapping min hole-to-edge, countersink min hole centre to edge): the page loads them from app.sendcutsend.com, a host this session may not fetch; not read. One worked figure (0.063 in. tapping min hole-to-edge, 0.125 in. 5052) was published in a blog post and is included.
Laser cutting of 6061 is offered but bending of 6061 is not listed (bending materials: 5052, brass, 4130, copper, G90, mild steel, polycarbonate, 304, 316, titanium grade 2).
Hardware catalog lists no S-M3-1, S-M5-x self-clinching nuts; the M3/M4 carbon-steel nuts are S-M3-0 and S-M4-0.
Hardware catalog: only metric self-clinching nuts (S-, SP-, F- families) were transcribed; studs (FH-) and standoffs (SO-) are in the catalog but not in this file.

notes.bend_radius: Bending guidelines (https://sendcutsend.com/services/cnc-bending/): 'Bend radius and K factor are set per material thickness. Design your parts using our specs so they form as expected, we don't offer custom bend radii.' A part modelled at another radius is formed at this one, so its flanges move: a warning, not a refusal.

rules.measured: smallest hole or cut-out (width of the largest inscribed circle for a non-round cut-out)
rules.note: The guideline page adds: 'the exact minimum changes with the material and thickness. The current values for every stock we carry live on each material's page' (those per-thickness values are loaded from app.sendcutsend.com and were not read).
rules.quote: Minimum hole and cutout size The pierce or tool entry needs a certain amount of room. Holes smaller than the minimum will distort, char, or fail to cut. | Method | Minimum hole/cutout | Laser Cutting | At least 50% of material thickness

rules.note: Contradicts the sheet-cutting guideline (50 % of thickness). Kept as a warning: the guideline page and pre-flight checklist accept 50 %.
rules.quote: Minimum hole size: Equal to material thickness (e.g., .125″ hole in .125″ sheet).
Minimum slot width: Material thickness or larger for clean results.

rules.measured: material between a hole's edge and the part's outer edge
rules.quote: Spacing from edges: Leave at least 2x thickness between a hole and an edge.

rules.note: Under 'For best results'. Contradicts the 50 % guideline minimum.
rules.quote: Design holes no smaller than material thickness.

rules.note: Range published; the lower end (1.5 x thickness) is used as the limit.
rules.quote: Keep holes and cutouts 1.5–2× material thickness away from edges to prevent warping or distortion.

rules.measured: least material between two cut features, or between a cut feature and the outer edge
rules.note: The sheet-cutting guideline adds 'Minimum bridge width varies by material, check the material specs for your stock' (per-thickness values not readable without app.sendcutsend.com).
rules.quote: We recommend that hole diameters and bridging widths be no less than 50% of the material thickness. For example, on a 0.125” thick part, this would mean having 0.0625” between all of your cut features, or cut features and the edge of your part.

rules.measured: least material between cut features or to the edge
rules.note: A preference, reported as information only (the 50 % figure above is the recommendation).
rules.quote: For strength and cut quality reasons, we would prefer that wall thickness or bridging be closer to 1X – 1.5X the material thickness.

rules.measured: material between a round hole's edge and the outer edge, against the hole's diameter
rules.quote: we generally recommend keeping your holes at least 1X their diameter from an edge and slots at least 1.5X their width away from edges or other cut features.

rules.measured: material between a non-round cut-out and the outer edge or the next cut feature, against the slot's width
rules.quote: we generally recommend keeping your holes at least 1X their diameter from an edge and slots at least 1.5X their width away from edges or other cut features.

rules.measured: share of the outline's area cut away inside it
rules.quote: Keep material removal under 50%. Designs above that may be rejected.
Laser-cuttable to ±.005” tolerance at SendCutSend in thicknesses from .040″–.500″.
